title: The Pneumoconiosis etc. (Workers’ Compensation) (Payment of Claims) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
The Transport and Works (Applications, Objections, Listed Buildings, Inquiries and Decisions Procedure) (England and Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend, subject to the transitional provisions in regulation 1, the Transport and Works (Inquiries Procedure) Rules 2004 (S.I. 2004/2018) (“the 2004 Rules”), the Transport and Works (Applications and Objections Procedure) (England and Wales) Rules 2006 (S.I. 2006/1466) (“the 2006 Rules”) and the Transport and Works Applications (Listed Buildings, Conservation Areas and Ancient Monuments Procedure) Regulations 1992 (“the 1992 Regulations”).

title: The Sea Fisheries (Amendment and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to assimilated law in the field of sea fisheries. They also make a transitional provision.

title: The English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 4) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations are the fourth commencement regulations under the 
English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23).

title: The Northern Ireland Troubles (Legacy and Reconciliation) Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2 and Transitional Provisions) (Amendment No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations amend the Northern Ireland Troubles (Legacy and Reconciliation) Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2024 (
S.I. 2024/584 (C. 36)) (“the 2024 Regulations”). The 2024 Regulations were the second set of commencement regulations made under the Northern Ireland Troubles (Legacy and Reconciliation) Act 2023 (c. 41).

title: The Education (Student Support for Postgraduate and Lifelong Learning Provision) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the Lifelong Learning (Student Support) (Amendment of Fees and Awards etc.) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/858) (“the Lifelong Learning Regulations”), the Education (Postgraduate Master’s Degree Loans) Regulations 2016 (S.I. 2016/606), the Education (Postgraduate Doctoral Degree Loans and the Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) (Amendment) (No. 2) etc.) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/599) and the Education (Student Support for Postgraduate Provision) (Amendment) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/581).

title: The English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Consequential Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Local Government Pension Scheme Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/2356) (“the 2013 Regulations”).

title: The Transport Infrastructure (Fees) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision for prescribed public authorities to charge fees for services provided in connection with certain transport infrastructure projects. They are made under powers inserted into the Highways Act 1980 (c. 66) (“the 1980 Act”) and the Transport and Works Act 1992 (c. 42) (“the 1992 Act”) by the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34).

title: The Bus Services Act 2025 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provision) (England) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the 
Bus Services Act 2025 (c. 24) (“the 2025 Act”). These are the third commencement Regulations made under the 2025 Act.

title: The Football Governance Act 2025 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Football Governance Act 2025 (c. 21) (“the Act”) on 29th October 2026 and 1st November 2026. Certain provisions came into force on Royal Assent by virtue of section 100(2). They are the fifth set of commencement Regulations made under the Act.

title: The Central Counterparties (Equivalence) (Indonesia and the People’s Republic of China) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations set out the Treasury’s equivalence determinations in respect of the regulatory framework that applies to certain central counterparties (CCPs) that are established in Indonesia and the People’s Republic of China.

title: The Wireless Telegraphy (Exemption) (Amendment) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Wireless Telegraphy (Exemption) Regulations 2021 (S.I. 2021/493) (“the 2021 Regulations”). The 2021 Regulations exempt the establishment, installation and use of wireless telegraphy stations or apparatus which comply with certain terms, provisions and limitations, from the requirement to be licensed under section 8(1) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 (c. 36).

title: The Wireless Telegraphy (Dynamic Spectrum Access Devices) (Exemption) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations exempt the use of dynamic spectrum access devices operating in the radio frequency band 5925 to 7125 MHz from the requirement to be licensed under section 8(1) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 (c. 36) (“the Act”).

title: The Wireless Telegraphy (Dynamic Spectrum Access Service) (Frequencies) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify the frequency band containing the frequencies about which a dynamic spectrum access service, registered by Ofcom under section 53A of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006, may provide information relating to their availability for use by wireless telegraphy stations and wireless telegraphy apparatus and the places in which, the power at which, the times at which and any conditions subject to which such stations and apparatus may use them.

title: The Individual Savings Account (Amendment) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Individual Savings Account Regulations 1998 (“the ISA Regulations”) in relation to Lifetime ISAs.

title: The Code of Practice (Access and Unfair Practices During the Recognition and Derecognition Process) Order 2026
summary: This Order brings into effect, on 30th October 2026, the Code of Practice issued by the Secretary of State under sections 203(1) and 204(2) of the Trade Union and Labour Relations (Consolidation) Act 1992 (c. 52) (“the 1992 Act”) on Access and Unfair Practices During the Recognition and Derecognition Process (“the Code of Practice on Access and Unfair Practices During the Recognition and Derecognition Process”), which revises and supersedes the Code of Practice on Access and Unfair Practices during Recognition and Derecognition Ballots, which came into effect on 1 October 2005. Article 3 makes transitional and saving provisions in relation to its coming into effect.

title: The Leasehold and Freehold Reform Act 2024 (Commencement No. 4 and Saving Provision) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Leasehold and Freehold Reform Act 2024 (c. 22) (“the Act”) in relation to England.

title: The English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the third commencement regulations under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23) (“the EDCEA 2026”).

title: The Victims and Prisoners Act 2024 (Commencement No. 12 and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force section 18 of the Victims and Prisoners Act 2024 (c. 21) (“the 2024 Act”). These are the twelfth commencement Regulations made under the 2024 Act.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Derry, Londonderry) Regulations 2026
